items.what: Ufuncs applied to a DataFrame must honor the numpy `dtype` keyword, returning a DataFrame whose dtypes are the requested dtype (np.float32) — the instruction only mentions the `out` parameter, never `dtype`.
items.quote:
result = np.positive(df, dtype=np.float32)
    assert all(d == np.float32 for d in result.dtypes)

reason: The instruction only describes fixing the `out` parameter for DataFrame ufunc dispatch; all out-related and preservation tests follow from that fix or guard existing behavior. The dtype-kwarg test requires extra semantics (dtype propagation to result dtypes) never mentioned in the issue, which a minimal out-fix would not implement.
